title: Splunk Security Advisories - 2026-06-17
description:
Merged 2 splunk security advisories published on 2026-06-17. Original advisory IDs: SVD-2026-0614, SVD-2026-0613

Titles:
- OS Command Injection in the btool Configuration Helper in Splunk AI Toolkit
- Insecure Default Domain Allowlist in Splunk AI Toolkit
solution:
Upgrade Splunk AI Toolkit to version 5.7.4 or higher.
